title: slack-notice notification (send --stdin-json, --file)
description: One notification. Unknown fields exit 20 invalid_payload. Text limits are applied after sanitizing by the tool; the bounds here only cap the raw input. Null is a wrong type: absent fields are omitted. Flag input (--title, --message, --level, --link) forms the same object.

title.description: Untrusted. One line (newlines become spaces); at most 256 characters after sanitizing, cut with an ellipsis and truncated: true when longer (not refused). Input over 100000 characters exits 20 invalid_payload.

message.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; empty after sanitizing (including an empty string) exits 20 empty_message, so there is no minLength.

link.description: Untrusted. A coarse gate: 1 to 1024 printable ASCII characters (U+0021 to U+007E). The tool, not the schema, applies the rest of the link rule (scheme token http or https compared case-insensitively, the host and port grammar, no userinfo) and names a violation: another scheme exits 20 with reason link_scheme, any other violation reason link_invalid. The tool is authoritative.
